registros.descricaoIngles: A seeker of secret knowledge hidden away in a tome-filled tower.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Orbiting Aegis
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a d6 Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

habilidadesIngles.name: Force Salvo
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend any number of Fear and roll that many d4s. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.

habilidadesIngles.name: Fireball
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark any number of Stress to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d10 magic damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Counterspell
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can spend a Fear to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll’s result. On a success, the PC’s Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can’t Counterspell a critical success.

registros.descricaoIngles: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.

habilidadesIngles.name: Attracted to Wealth
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

habilidadesIngles.name: The Weight of Opulence
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to turn the Catrin’s gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they’re carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

habilidadesIngles.name: Expensive Failure
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can mark a Stress to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

registros.descricaoIngles: A giant fire-breathing monster that has a lion’s head, a goat’s body, and a serpent’s tail.

habilidadesIngles.name: Rending Jaws
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Chimera makes a successful attack against a PC, the target must mark 2 Armor Slots to reduce the severity by one threshold.

habilidadesIngles.name: Double Claw
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Breath of Fire
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Chimera within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed must choose to mark either an Armor Slot or a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Serpent Strike
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC within Close range targets the Chimera with an attack, you can mark a Stress to attack the PC first. On a success, deal 4d4+10 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

registros.descricaoIngles: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

habilidadesIngles.name: “Awww...”
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Lepus first appears, it is Too Cute. To attack a Too Cute creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the Too Cute condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

habilidadesIngles.name: Terrifying
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Leaping Jugular Strike
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20 direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Evasive
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Lepus would take damage, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: “Run Away!”
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

registros.descricaoIngles: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.

habilidadesIngles.name: Terrifying
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Psychic Screech
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend 2 Fear to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take 3d8 direct magic damage and become Vulnerable until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Shadow Swarm
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren’t Cryptimoths are Vulnerable while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

habilidadesIngles.name: Paranoia Glare
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them Paranoid. While Paranoid, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can’t Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

registros.descricaoIngles: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.

habilidadesIngles.name: Fish-Tailed
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Merfolk is Vulnerable out of the water.

habilidadesIngles.name: Gang Up
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

habilidadesIngles.name: “Get Over Here!”
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

registros.descricaoIngles: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.

habilidadesIngles.name: Psychic Blast
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take 3d10+4 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

habilidadesIngles.name: Brain Drain
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to choose a Vulnerable PC within Very Close range. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Call of the Deep
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

habilidadesIngles.name: Mucosal Contamination
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is Restrained until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs Restrained in this way take 3d8 direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures Restrained by it when it’s defeated or takes Severe damage.

registros.descricaoIngles: A clawed quadruped that has a scaled, serpentine body and a willingness to serve its cousins, the dragons.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (2)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Drake can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Guard Dog
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can mark a Stress to have the Drake move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. If the attacker is within Melee range of the Drake’s new position, you can immediately spotlight the Drake without spending Fear.

registros.descricaoIngles: A horse-mounted specter holding their own severed head in one hand and wielding a whip fashioned from a human spine in the other.

habilidadesIngles.name: Specter
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Dullahan has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

habilidadesIngles.name: Spectral Mount
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: While atop their steed, the Dullahan can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action. If the Dullahan is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again. The Dullahan is Vulnerable while not on their horse.

habilidadesIngles.name: Bone Whip Strike
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 4d4+10 direct physical damage and is Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Death Glare
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. The target must make an Presence Reaction Roll (19). On a success, they mark a Stress. On a failure, they mark a HP and activate a Doom Countdown (4). It ticks down when the Dullahan is spotlighted. When it triggers, the target makes a death move. If the Dullahan is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

registros.descricaoIngles: The shade of a forgotten ruler, cursed to patrol the skies atop a winged eel in the service of an even greater evil.

habilidadesIngles.name: Fellmount
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: While the Shadow King is on his mount, he gains a +2 bonus to his Difficulty. When the Shadow King takes Severe damage, he’s knocked from his mount. If the Shadow King is unmounted, his mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

habilidadesIngles.name: Light and Shadow
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls while in shadow or darkness and disadvantage on attack rolls while in bright light.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relic Hunter
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls against PCs who have magic weapons or armor equipped.

habilidadesIngles.name: Hellsong
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend 2 Fear to have the Shadow King’s mount unleash a spine-chilling screech that echoes over the battlefield. Each PC within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll (18). Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope. If a PC can’t lose a Hope, you gain 2 Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Air Support
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to have an ally within Far range reroll a failed attack with advantage.

registros.descricaoIngles: An armor-clad goliath who has ash-gray skin and fiery hair and wields a masterwork greatsword crafted in their own smithy.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Masterwork Armor
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Countdown (3). When the Titan first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Titan takes Major or Severe damage. Until the countdown triggers, reduce incoming damage by 1d12. When it triggers, the Titan gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

habilidadesIngles.name: Momentum
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Hurl Rock
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range, then make an attack against all targets between the Titan and that point. Targets the Titan succeeds against take 3d12 physical damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Skull Splitter
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to place a token on this stat block. The next time the Titan is spotlighted, you must spend the token from this stat block and make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, deal 3d20+5 direct physical damage. On a failure, the target marks a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Blazing Heart
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Titan marks half or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

registros.descricaoIngles: A blue-skinned goliath who has rimed hair and wears trophies of past battles.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (2)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: War Horn
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until after the next attack against them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Bull Rush
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d10+2 physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.

habilidadesIngles.name: Cleaving Strike
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC marks HP from the Titan’s standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Trophy Hunter
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC’s most valuable possession as a trophy.

registros.descricaoIngles: A monstrous sea turtle that has an adamantine shell and beak.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Turtle can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Piercing Bite
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Turtle makes a successful standard attack against a PC, the PC must either mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefit or take double damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Tail Bash
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all PCs behind the Turtle within Very Close range. On a success, a target takes an extra 1d12 physical damage and is pushed away from the Turtle to Close range.

habilidadesIngles.name: Gigaton Splash
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Turtle use its weight to unleash an unstoppable wall of water that targets all creatures within Far range. Each PC must make a Strength Reaction Roll to navigate the tide. Targets who fail are pushed away from the Turtle to Close range, take 4d8 physical damage, and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Steam Breath
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend 2 Fear to have the Turtle release a blast of superheated steam targeting all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8 magic damage and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must choose to either mark a Stress or take half damage.

registros.descricaoIngles: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.

habilidadesIngles.name: Constriction
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

habilidadesIngles.name: Life Leech
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4−1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Sleep Toxin
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

motivacoesIngles: speak through a shapeshifted head stalk
registros.descricaoIngles: A huge aquatic creature that lures unwary prey into eating range with its dangling, shapeshifting head stalk.

habilidadesIngles.name: Doppel-Dangler
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler’s head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form. Mark a Stress to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler’s head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

habilidadesIngles.name: Entice
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler’s head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

habilidadesIngles.name: Gulp
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC moves within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes 3d6 physical damage and is Swallowed. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and takes 3d6 physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

registros.descricaoIngles: A legendary beast that has a human’s face, lion’s body, scorpion’s tail, and dragon’s wings.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Riddle Me This
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

habilidadesIngles.name: Winged
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

habilidadesIngles.name: Pouncing Attack
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

habilidadesIngles.name: Locking Jaws
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

registros.descricaoIngles: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.

habilidadesIngles.name: Horde (2d6+2)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+2 physical damage instead.

habilidadesIngles.name: Swell Ranks
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde’s ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

habilidadesIngles.name: Overwhelm
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

motivacoesIngles: tempt them with their deepest desires
registros.descricaoIngles: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suffering and ecstasy.

habilidadesIngles.name: Walk Between Worlds
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

habilidadesIngles.name: Pleasure and Pain
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

registros.descricaoIngles: A huge eagle that’s made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Purifying Aura
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix’s Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

habilidadesIngles.name: Fireseed
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range.

habilidadesIngles.name: Resurrection
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Phoenix is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals 3d4 direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

registros.descricaoIngles: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.

habilidadesIngles.name: Only a Rumor
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can’t be located or targeted.

habilidadesIngles.name: Wall of Water
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

registros.descricaoIngles: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Bird of Prey
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

habilidadesIngles.name: Here Comes the Boom
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take 3d12 magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Crushing Grasp
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

habilidadesIngles.name: Nest Warden
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Roc’s eggs are threatened, it gains the following features: Wrathful - Passive: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

habilidadesIngles.name: Electrifying Aura
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

registros.descricaoIngles: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.

habilidadesIngles.name: Venomous Tail Stinger
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d10+2 physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained and Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

habilidadesIngles.name: Devour
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Hungry, Not Stupid
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

registros.descricaoIngles: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.

habilidadesIngles.name: Fiendish Nature
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can’t be fooled by magic illusions.

habilidadesIngles.name: Impersonate
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they’re in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Turn Invisible
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make the Fiend Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Backhanded Guidance
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can mark a Stress to add 1d6 to the result of their Fear Die. Exposed!

habilidadesIngles.name: (Phase Change)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

registros.descricaoIngles: A towering humanoid who has an insectile head and multiple sets of glowing red eyes.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Fiendish Resistance
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can’t be fooled by magic illusions.

habilidadesIngles.name: Demonic Rage
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with a bonus to the attack roll equal the amount of Stress the Fiend has marked. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Hall of Mirrors
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark 2 Stress to have the Fiend summon four illusory duplicates and activate a Duplicate Countdown (4). When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die’s current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

habilidadesIngles.name: Flash Claw
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend unleash an arc of magical energy. Make an attack roll against all targets within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 3d20 magic damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Mind Games
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When an attack targeting the Fiend from beyond Very Close range succeeds with Fear, you can mark a Stress to have the Fiend instantly switch places with a PC within Very Close range. The PC takes the damage instead.

registros.descricaoIngles: An ancient, wise, and temperamental goliath who has hair made of mist and electricity crackling across their skin.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Momentum
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Ball Lightning
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Titan conjure 1d4 spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range. When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes 4d6 magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Storm Bringer
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Thunderclap
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

registros.descricaoIngles: A celestial avatar of goodness in the form of a preternaturally beautiful horse with a long, spiraled horn emerging from its head.

habilidadesIngles.name: Celestial Lance
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Unicorn’s standard attack deals double damage to a creature that has dealt damage to it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Healing Touch
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Unicorn touches its horn to an ally within Melee range and channels healing energy into them. Mark any number of Stress to clear an equal number of the ally’s HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Protective Aura
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn conjure a sparkling magical aura. While the aura is in effect, attack rolls made against the Unicorn or an ally within Very Close range are made with disadvantage. This effect lasts until the Unicorn takes damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Teleport
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn teleport up to Very Far range. The Unicorn can bring up to three allies within Very Close range with it.

registros.descricaoIngles: A cloud of blood-sucking bats.

habilidadesIngles.name: Horde (2d6)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6 physical damage instead.

habilidadesIngles.name: Blinding Multitude
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

habilidadesIngles.name: Bloodsuckers
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.

registros.descricaoIngles: A cruel vampire lord from a long-lost age, cursed with immortality.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Vampire Lord can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Midnight Heart
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Long-Term Countdown (6). The Vampire Lord keeps their heart hidden in a safe place. If it’s destroyed, the Vampire Lord dies. Otherwise, when the Vampire Lord is defeated, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the PCs finish a long rest. When it triggers, the Vampire Lord revives within Close range of the heart with all HP and Stress cleared.

habilidadesIngles.name: Terrifying
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Vampire Lord makes a successful attack roll, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Unleash Hellfire
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Vampire Lord momentarily conjure 1d4 bursts of hellfire within Far range. Each burst deals 3d6 magic damage to each target within Very Close range. If a target takes damage from multiple bursts, combine the damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Resurgence
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Hope, you can spend a Fear to clear a HP or a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Melt into Shadow
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC would deal damage to the Vampire Lord, you can spend a Fear to roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, negate the damage, then teleport the Vampire Lord to a point within Far range.

habilidadesIngles.name: Hellwing
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Vampire Lord marks half their HP, they transform into the Hellwing: a towering, demonic bat creature. They gain the “On Crimson Wings” and “Bloodbath” features and replace their standard attack with the following standard attack: Claws: Close | 3d12+6 phy

habilidadesIngles.name: On Crimson Wings
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: While flying, the Hellwing gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

habilidadesIngles.name: Bloodbath
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Hellwing takes Major or greater damage, the ground within Very Close range is covered with blood, dealing 3d10 magic damage to all other creatures in the area. When the Hellwing takes the spotlight on subsequent GM turns, all other creatures in that area take 3d6 magic damage.

registros.descricaoIngles: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.

habilidadesIngles.name: Join or Die
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn’t reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

habilidadesIngles.name: Entangling Entrails
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, Restraining them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

habilidadesIngles.name: Lifesuck
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a Restrained target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.

registros.descricaoIngles: The echoes of broken promises and dreams unfulfilled, manifesting as a floating, translucent shroud of tattered black velvet in a vaguely humanoid shape.

habilidadesIngles.name: Greater Specter
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

habilidadesIngles.name: Spooky
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress, and you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Nightmare Shroud
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within Melee range, Shrouding the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While Shrouded, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and marks a Stress when they roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the Shrouded target.

registros.descricaoIngles: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.

habilidadesIngles.name: Double Strike
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Terrifying Shriek
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are Terrified until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While Terrified, a PC doesn’t gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

habilidadesIngles.name: Clutch
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to have the Wyvern Restrain the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

registros.descricaoIngles: A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Intimidating
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a Hope.

habilidadesIngles.name: Flame Breath
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Eruption
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming Vulnerable until their next rest. You gain a Fear for each PC who fails.

habilidadesIngles.name: Blazing Scales
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Slash and Burn
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you gain a Fear and can mark a Stress to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

registros.descricaoIngles: A lumbering, bog-grown frog beast that has tadpolelike leeches visibly wriggling underneath their translucent skin.

habilidadesIngles.name: Toxic Skin
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an Armor Slot or 2 HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Bear Hug
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is Grappled until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Grappled, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained.

habilidadesIngles.name: Crunch!
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to deal 4d12 direct physical damage to a creature Grappled by the Abomination.

habilidadesIngles.name: Tongue Attack
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Abomination pull a target within Far range into Melee range, then immediately spotlight the Abomination again.

habilidadesIngles.name: Burrowing Leechpoles
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. Each PC within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail are covered in 2d4 leechpoles, which burrow under their skin. Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

registros.descricaoIngles: A squidlike parasite that latches onto their prey’s skull, bathing the victim’s brain in extradimensional neurotoxins.

habilidadesIngles.name: Minion (12)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

habilidadesIngles.name: Comatize
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within Melee range. The PC must mark a Stress as the Hatchling injects the PC’s brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress they have marked. If a PC marks their last Stress while the Hatchling is latched on, the PC must make a death move. If the PC dies, you can spend a Fear to resurrect them as a Cephilith Novitiate.

habilidadesIngles.name: Group Attack
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Hatchlings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

registros.descricaoIngles: A luminary of the Mortal Realm who has given their mind to extradimensional entities in exchange for eldritch abilities.

habilidadesIngles.name: Minion (12)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

habilidadesIngles.name: Group Attack
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Novitiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Sacrifice Self
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

motivacoesIngles: prepare this world for the Cephilith Titan’s arrival
registros.descricaoIngles: A perpetually moist, faceless humanoid from the Outer Realms who has elongated fingers and translucent skin, under which one can see wriggling worms.

habilidadesIngles.name: Psychic Blast
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs within Close range and force them to make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 2d10+5 direct magic damage. Targets who fail take 4d10+10 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

habilidadesIngles.name: Cerebral Incursion
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose a Vulnerable target within Melee range. The Priest grabs the target and inserts their elongated fingers into the target’s ears, nose, and mouth. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d6 Stress, and the Priest clears an equal number of Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Telekinetic Grasp
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they spend a Hope.

registros.descricaoIngles: A transdimensional entity in the form of an impossibly large, winged humanoid with an octopus-shaped head and rows of glowing eyes.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (X)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Titan can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X equals the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Terrifying
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Titan makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Merely a Projection
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating their true form. They have immunity to physical damage and resistance to magic damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Psychic Scream
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Titan unleash a mind-shattering onslaught of nightmarish visions from the Outer Realms. Each PC within Far range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (22). Targets who fail take 4d12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Summon Worshippers
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to summon 1d4 Cephilith Abominations, which appear within Far range, then choose one to immediately spotlight.

habilidadesIngles.name: “It’s Here…”
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Titan has marked half their HP, they manifest in their full form, clearing all HP and losing the “Merely a Projection” feature. While the Titan is in this form, a creature who marks HP from the Titan’s standard attack must mark an additional HP.

registros.descricaoIngles: A gargantuan crocodile that has a body covered in a patchwork of fish scales, toad skin, and dozens of hungry mouths.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Cipactli can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Many Mouths
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Cipactli succeeds against must also mark a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Frenzied Feeding
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Close range to succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 4d6 direct physical damage. The Cipactli clears a HP for each creature who took Severe damage from this attack.

habilidadesIngles.name: Quaking Footfalls
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until they take damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Lifeblooded
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Cipactli takes Severe damage, its blood splashes to the ground and instantly erupts into a jungle. All creatures within Close range are temporarily Restrained.

habilidadesIngles.name: Verdant Explosion
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Cipactli marks its last HP, its body erupts into dense vegetation that overtakes the landscape.

motivacoesIngles: never pass up an interesting wager
registros.descricaoIngles: A devastatingly attractive, blue-skinned goliath dressed in the finest silks and dripping with jewelry. They luxuriate in the finer things and dwell in a sky palace filled with treasure.

habilidadesIngles.name: Lightning Strike
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+14 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the lightning bounces, and the Titan makes this attack against a different target within Very Close range of the previous target. Each time the lightning bounces, decrease the damage it deals by 1d10.

habilidadesIngles.name: Mist Weaver
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. The Titan conjures a thick fog over the area within Close range of that point. The Titan is Hidden to enemies within and on the other side of the fog and has advantage on attacks against creatures inside it. The fog lasts until the Titan marks HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Nebulous Transformation
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Titan transform into a misty cloud that fills a Very Close area. While in this form, the Titan takes double magic damage and has immunity to physical damage. This form lasts until the Titan chooses to drop out of it or takes Severe damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Unleash the Menagerie
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to summon an equal number of Griffins, which appear at Close range.

habilidadesIngles.name: Wind Worker
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Titan blast wind at a target within Close range. The target takes 4d6+8 physical damage and is pushed back to Far range from their current position.

habilidadesIngles.name: Double or Nothing
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When you would gain a Fear from an attack against the Titan, you can roll a d6. On an odd result, you don’t gain the Fear. On an even result, you gain 2 Fear instead of 1.

registros.descricaoIngles: The ruler of a deep circle in the Circles Below and a huge hybrid beast with a serpent’s tail, a lizard’s hind legs, a crab’s claw arms, and a two-faced wolf’s head.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Berzug can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Chaos Lash
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have Berzug lash at up to three PCs within Close range and force each target to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Gaze into the Abyss
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have Berzug lock eyes with a PC within Far range. The target must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or gain one of the following conditions (roll a d6 and use the corresponding result): 1–2: Mesmerized. The target immediately moves into Melee range of Berzug and is Vulnerable and Restrained until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll. 3–4: Confused. The target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll until they clear the condition with a successful Knowledge Roll. 5–6: Enthralled. Until the PC makes a successful Presence Roll to clear the condition, you can spotlight them during a GM turn as if they were an adversary. When you do so, choose a target within Close range of the Enthralled PC. The Enthralled PC moves into Melee range of the target and makes a weapon attack against them using a d20 instead of Duality Dice.

habilidadesIngles.name: Crushing Strike
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC marks HP from Berzug’s standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force them to mark a number of Stress equal to the number of HP they marked. You gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Horrifying
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC fails an attack against Berzug, you gain a Fear.

registros.descricaoIngles: A gargantuan seven-headed dragon with dazzling diamond scales that shine with every color of the rainbow.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mitera can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

habilidadesIngles.name: Diamond Hide
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Countdown (7). When Mitera first appears, activate the countdown. Mitera gains a bonus to her Difficulty equal to the countdown die’s current value. It ticks down from Mitera’s “Seven-Headed” feature. When the countdown triggers, Mitera becomes Vulnerable and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

habilidadesIngles.name: Elemental Breath
habilidadesIngles.rulesText:
Mark a Stress to have Mitera unleash elemental energy from one head of your choice: 1. Fire. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d4+1 targets within Close range. Targets who take damage must mark an Armor Slot or 2 additional HP.

2. Lightning. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d6 targets within Far range, so long as each target beyond the first is within Close range of the previous target.
3. Acid. Each PC in front of Mitera within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Armor Slots and 2 HP. Targets who succeed must mark an Armor Slot and a HP.
4. Poison. A miasma of toxic swamp gas Sickens all targets within Close range of Mitera. While Sickened, a target has disadvantage on action rolls until they mark 1d4 Stress to clear the condition.
5. Ice. Each target in front of Mitera within Close range takes 4d8+8 magic damage and is Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Additionally, this area freezes over and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll to move through it.
6. Darkness. A cloud of magical shadow fills an area within Close range. Creatures inside the cloud except for Mitera are Vulnerable and have disadvantage on action rolls that rely on sight. The cloud dissipates when this Elemental Breath option is removed by Mitera’s “Seven-Headed” feature.
7. Light. A beam of pure light energy deals 28 direct magic damage to each creature in a line within Very Far range.

habilidadesIngles.name: Tail Swipe
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to attack all targets within Close range. Targets this attack succeeds against take 2d20+10 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range. Targets who mark HP from this attack become Vulnerable until they clear a HP. Targets this attack failed against must mark a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Fearsome
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When Mitera makes a successful attack roll against a PC or a PC fails a roll within Far range, you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Seven-Headed
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When Mitera takes damage, roll a d8. Permanently remove the “Elemental Breath” option that corresponds to the result. On a result of 8, or if the corresponding option has already been removed, tick down the Diamond Hide countdown (see “Diamond Hide”).

registros.descricaoIngles: A smoldering, battle-obsessed goliath wearing bespoke armor and wielding a massive maul.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (2)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Warlord can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Colossus Crafter
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Countdown (6). When the Warlord enters the scene, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Warlord is spotlighted. When it triggers, summon the Gargantuan War Machine, which appears at the edge of the battlefield and immediately takes the spotlight.

habilidadesIngles.name: Release the Hounds
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord summon two Demonic Hound Packs, which appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

habilidadesIngles.name: Spinning Strike
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range and gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Ground-Breaking
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord crack the earth with a downward swing of their maul and make an attack against a group within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d10+10 direct damage. The area becomes rough terrain, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

registros.descricaoIngles: A 100-foot-tall adamantine construct that has gemstone eyes, powered by a chest crucible of elemental flame.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Machine can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Awesome Size
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Machine enters the battlefield, each PC must either lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Rocket Punch
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d12+10 direct physical damage and marks 2 Armor Slots without gaining their benefits.

habilidadesIngles.name: Ground-Breaking Stomp
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose a point within Close range and make an attack roll against all enemies within Close range of that point. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d12 direct physical damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Additionally, the entire area becomes rubble, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Supercharged
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Machine is spotlighted for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the Machine is spotlighted. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block as the Machine’s chest crucible flares with magical flame. For each token on this stat block, the Machine gains a +1 bonus to Difficulty and attack rolls, and its standard attack deals an extra 1d12 damage. Remove a token when the Machine takes Severe damage.

registros.descricaoIngles: A teeming army of ghosts roused from dreamless slumber to fulfill their ancient oath.

habilidadesIngles.name: Horde (2d6+5)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Legion has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6+5 magic damage instead.

habilidadesIngles.name: Necroplasmic
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Legion is immune to physical damage and takes double magic damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Final Act
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Legion is defeated, it makes a standard attack against all targets within Close range before being dispelled.

registros.descricaoIngles: A large leonine creature that has the head, talons, and wings of an eagle.

habilidadesIngles.name: Treasure Hoarder
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC would mark any number of HP from the Griffin’s attack, the PC can choose instead to give the Griffin an equal number of bags of gold.

habilidadesIngles.name: Swooping Slash
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target along the way.

registros.descricaoIngles: A heavenly host of winged humanoids whose song calls forth tears of religious awe.

habilidadesIngles.name: Horde (2d10)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Choir has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d10 magic damage instead.

habilidadesIngles.name: Celestial Coda
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Countdown (Loop 3). The Choir’s divine song builds on itself with each refrain. When the Choir first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC gains a Hope. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block. The Choir gains a bonus to its damage rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block.

habilidadesIngles.name: Aural Assault
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Choir unleashes its built-up divine energy in a single burst, clearing all tokens from this stat block. Deal 1d12 direct magic damage to each enemy within Close range for each token cleared.

registros.descricaoIngles: A desiccated corpse riding atop a skeletal horse. Their eyes are sewn shut and their body is wrapped in a burial shroud of dust and ash.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Mount
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

habilidadesIngles.name: Fear the Reaper
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a creature is defeated within Far range of the Harbinger, you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Decapitate
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger make an attack roll against a PC within Melee range. On a success, roll a d6. On a result of 6, the target marks all HP and must make a death move.

habilidadesIngles.name: Wake the Fallen
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to have the Harbinger resurrect a defeated ally within Far range. The resurrected ally clears a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked. Immediately spotlight the ally.

habilidadesIngles.name: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Harbinger would mark HP, you can mark a Stress to have an ally within Far range mark the HP instead.

registros.descricaoIngles: A dried-out husk of a body riding atop a withered white horse. They are covered in mouths and surrounded by swarming flies.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (2)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Mount
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

habilidadesIngles.name: Hunger Pangs
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Countdown (Decreasing 6). When the Harbinger appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Harbinger is spotlighted. When it triggers, all PCs within Far range mark a Stress and become Ravenous. While Ravenous, a PC can’t spend Hope until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.

habilidadesIngles.name: Drain Essence
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs. Each target takes 4d6 magic damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Too Many Mouths
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to attack a PC within Melee range. On a success, the Harbinger grabs the target and bites them, dealing 4d6 physical damage and Restraining the target until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.

habilidadesIngles.name: Withering Touch
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger caress the face of a Restrained PC within Melee range. The target marks 2 Stress and either loses a Hope or marks 1d4 HP.

registros.descricaoIngles: A bloated and rotting agglomeration of wriggling insects and slugs formed into a single humanoid mass riding a worm-eaten horse.

habilidadesIngles.name: Halo of Contagion
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Harbinger is Contagious. When a PC within Very Close range of a Contagious creature takes an action, the PC rolls a d6. On a result of 1, the PC becomes Contagious. While Contagious, a PC has disadvantage on action rolls until they spend 3 Hope to clear the condition. Contagious adversaries are unaffected by the condition.

habilidadesIngles.name: Mount
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

habilidadesIngles.name: Locust Swarm
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a swarm of locusts at a point within Very Far range. Each PC within Close range of that point must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d10 direct physical damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1–2, the PC becomes Contagious.

habilidadesIngles.name: Frog Spawn
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a clutch of diseased frogs inside the mouths of up to three PCs within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 4d12 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1–3, the PC becomes Contagious.

habilidadesIngles.name: Plague Bringer
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark any number of Stress up to the number of PCs in the scene. For each Stress you mark, the Harbinger summons 1d4 Contagious Zombie Legions within Far range and immediately spotlights one of them.

registros.descricaoIngles: A warrior clad in black armor and a horned helmet and bearing a bloody banner.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (2)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Mount
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

habilidadesIngles.name: Iron Dice
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Harbinger attempt a risky all-out attack. Make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, the target marks an additional HP. On a failure, the Harbinger becomes Vulnerable until they take or deal damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Supreme Commander
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Once per scene, spend a Fear to summon 1d6 Hallowed Soldiers within Close range and immediately spotlight one of them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Battering Ram
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC fails an action roll within Close range, you can spend a Fear to move into Melee range with the PC and make a standard attack with advantage against them. On a success, the PC takes standard damage and is Vulnerable until they are spotlighted.

registros.descricaoIngles: A giant, vengeful barn owl that has a 15-foot wingspan and a human face.

habilidadesIngles.name: Ill Omen
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a PC within Close range makes an action roll, their Fear Die gains a bonus equal to the amount of Fear you have.

habilidadesIngles.name: Witch Barrier
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Owl Witch has resistance to magic damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Voice Mimicry
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch beckon with the voice of a beloved figure to a creature within earshot. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or move up to Far range toward the Owl Witch.

habilidadesIngles.name: Nightmare Stare
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch Aﬄict a PC within Far range with waking nightmares unless the target succeeds on a Knowledge Reaction Roll. While Aﬄicted, the target can’t clear HP or Stress. The condition is cleared when another PC uses a downtime move to comfort the Aﬄicted creature.

habilidadesIngles.name: Visions of a Violent End
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Owl Witch is targeted by an attack, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must mark 1d4 Stress as their mind is flooded with harrowing imagery.

registros.descricaoIngles: A huge winged dragon that has visible flames beneath its glittering, gem-encrusted scales. Its body heat melts stone.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (3)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Fearsome
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Dragon succeeds on an attack against a PC or a PC within Far range fails an action roll, you gain a Fear.

habilidadesIngles.name: Melting Breath
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Dragon unleash a blast of fire on all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d12+10 magic damage and mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

habilidadesIngles.name: Volcanic Fissure
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within Close range. Each PC within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take 4d8+5 magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes 4d8+5 magic damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Hot-Blooded
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within Very Close range, the Dragon’s blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an Armor Slot. If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they mark 1d4 HP.

registros.descricaoIngles: A two-dimensional living shadow bound to flat planes and surfaces.

habilidadesIngles.name: Minion (12)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

habilidadesIngles.name: Shadow Grapple
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

habilidadesIngles.name: Group Attack
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Severed Shadows within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

registros.descricaoIngles: The four-faced angel from the Hallows Above who manifests in the Mortal Realm as a floating tetrahedron with numerous eyes and multiple sets of metallic feathered wings.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (4)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Adonix can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Elemental Archon
habilidadesIngles.rulesText:
Mark a Stress to roll a d4. Adonix activates the corresponding effect: 1. Fire Beam. Adonix manifests a beam of elemental fire with a Very Close width from themself to the edge of the battlefield. Each target in the beam’s path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take Severe damage. Targets who succeed take Minor damage.

2. Thunderclap. All creatures within Far range must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they succeed on an attack roll or the Demiurge is defeated.
3. Lightning Bolt. Make an attack against a target within Very Far range, dealing 4d8 magic damage on a success. If all results are even, make the same attack against a different target, repeating the cycle until you roll an odd result or run out of targets.
4. Ice Storm. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d4 Stress and become Restrained until they spend a Hope to escape.

habilidadesIngles.name: Alpha to Omega
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When Adonix is defeated, they resurrect in Omega form with all HP and Stress cleared. Each PC within Very Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or lose a Hope. You gain a Fear for each Hope lost in this way.

habilidadesIngles.name: Adonix gains the following features in this form: Forsaken
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose a PC and activate a Forsaken Countdown (1d8) for them. It ticks down when Adonix is spotlighted. When it triggers, the PC must mark all their HP. The countdown ends if Adonix takes Severe damage. You can have only one Forsaken Countdown active at a time.

habilidadesIngles.name: Armageddon
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When Adonix is defeated again, they unleash a reality storm that shakes the realms to their foundations. Roll a d6. On a result of 5–6, each PC must make a death move.

registros.descricaoIngles: A giant mechanical being from a dimension outside time, built by the Time Keepers to preserve the Holy Continuum.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (2)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Enforcer can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Time Looper
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Enforcer first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Enforcer is spotlighted. When it triggers, the Enforcer clears all HP, Stress, and conditions. Reroll the countdown when the Enforcer takes Severe damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Move Between Moments
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to have the Enforcer teleport to a point within Very Far range, then spotlight them again.

habilidadesIngles.name: Instant Rewind
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Enforcer fails an attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the die.

habilidadesIngles.name: Invert Polarity
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to flip any die rolled onto its obverse result. This effect can’t be used to alter a critical success.

registros.descricaoIngles: A colossal fur-covered snake that hunts in large bodies of water.

habilidadesIngles.name: Segmented
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Water Mother’s body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The Water Mother always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the Water Mother with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the Water Mother can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the Water Mother and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Eat the World
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have the Water Mother inhale sharply. Each PC within Close range of her Head must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and be pulled within Melee range of the Head. The Water Mother then makes a standard attack against all targets within Melee range of her Head.

habilidadesIngles.name: Constrict
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Melee range of the Center segment. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d8+8 physical damage and are temporarily Restrained. At the beginning of each GM turn, you can mark a Stress to force all targets Restrained by the Water Mother to mark a HP.

habilidadesIngles.name: Venom Surge
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Water Mother makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable until the end of the scene.

registros.descricaoIngles: A reptilian biped created by mysterious and ancient dragon magic. Wyrmfiends exist more as extensions of their draconic master’s will than as individual beings.

habilidadesIngles.name: Minion (13)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: The Wyrmfiend is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Wyrmfiend, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

habilidadesIngles.name: Venomous Bite
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d4+4 physical damage and Poison the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, the target must mark a Stress.

habilidadesIngles.name: Group Attack
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Wyrmfiends within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

registros.descricaoIngles: A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they’re furious, hungry, and stupid.

habilidadesIngles.name: Horde (2d6+5)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

habilidadesIngles.name: Ravenous
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can spend a Fear to spotlight the Wyrmlings again.

habilidadesIngles.name: Overwhelm
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: When the Wyrmlings take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

registros.descricaoIngles: A castle-sized, bipedal reptile.

habilidadesIngles.name: Relentless (X)
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

habilidadesIngles.name: Collateral Damage
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Xero’s movement can’t be hindered, impeded, or affected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero’s path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

habilidadesIngles.name: Gigaton Stomp
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within Melee range takes 4d12 physical damage and is Restrained until they wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll. Each creature beyond Melee range but within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be knocked back to Far range. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d12 physical damage as they land.

habilidadesIngles.name: Power Slide
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or choose to either mark 2 Armor Slots or take Severe damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Radioactive Breath
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Spend a Fear to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can spend this token and unleash a beam to Very Far range. The beam has a width of Close range. Each PC in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d12+12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can’t use this feature again until it takes Severe damage.

habilidadesIngles.name: Regeneration
habilidadesIngles.rulesText: Up to three times per scene, spend any number of Fear to clear an equal number of HP.
